### How to work in this repo

Repowise tools are MCP tools: call them as `mcp__repowise__<tool>` (`mcp__plugin_repowise_repowise__<tool>` when Repowise is installed as a Claude Code plugin).
- Exact identifier, string or file name: Grep, Glob and Read are faster.
- How X works or flows end to end: `get_answer(question="how does ...")`, one question per call.
- Callers before a rename or signature change: `get_context(targets=["<symbol>"], include=["references"])`.
- What breaks if X changes: `get_risk(targets=["<file>"])`.
- Why X is shaped this way, before changing a pattern: `get_why(query="why ...", targets=["<file>"])`.
- Before finishing a multi-file change: `get_change_risk(revspec="<base>..HEAD")`, then `get_health(targets=["<files you touched>"])`.
- Read a file before you Edit it; Claude Code requires that Read. An empty `callers` list comes with a `*_basis`: read it before concluding nothing calls a symbol.
- No model on this index: `get_answer` is low confidence by design, so open its top `candidate_files`; search is full-text only. A model needs a provider key and `repowise generate`; suggest it, do not run it.
- Noisy commands (tests, builds, `git log`/`diff`): `repowise distill <cmd>`. A `[repowise#<ref>: N lines omitted]` marker is restored by `repowise expand <ref>`; never re-run the command.
- Record a decision you reasoned out: `repowise decision add --agent <your slug> --title T --decision D --rationale '<why>' --affects <path> --evidence-commit <sha>`; accept a candidate with `repowise decision confirm <id> --agent <your slug> --evidence <commit|file>`.
